title: kaizen
summary: A Japanese word for steady, continuous improvement.
definition: A Japanese word for steady, continuous improvement.

title: manas
summary: Sanskrit for mind or consciousness. Also the agent's short name.
definition: Sanskrit for mind or consciousness. Also the agent's short name.

title: harness
summary: The code around a language model: chat adapters, tools, safety checks and memory.
definition: The code around a language model: chat adapters, tools, safety checks and memory.

title: agent
summary: The model plus the harness, acting through tools.
definition: The model plus the harness, acting through tools.

title: gateway
summary: The part that talks to Telegram or Discord.
definition: The part that talks to Telegram or Discord.

title: tool
summary: A function the model can ask the harness to run.
definition: A function the model can ask the harness to run.

title: tool group
summary: A set of tools switched on or off together.
definition: A set of tools switched on or off together.

title: allow-list
summary: The list of user ids that may use the bot.
definition: The list of user ids that may use the bot.

title: approval gate
summary: The check that stops risky actions until the owner presses a button.
definition: The check that stops risky actions until the owner presses a button.

title: Allow Once
summary: Approve this one call.
definition: Approve this one call.

title: Allow Session
summary: Approve similar non-HIGH calls until reset or restart.
definition: Approve similar non-HIGH calls until reset or restart.

title: Always Allow
summary: Approve one exact command from now on.
definition: Approve one exact command from now on.

title: /allow window
summary: A time-boxed period with no prompts.
definition: A time-boxed period with no prompts.

title: hard block
summary: A rule that refuses even when the owner would allow it.
definition: A rule that refuses even when the owner would allow it.

title: sandbox
summary: A limited place to run code.
definition: A limited place to run code.

title: process group
summary: A set of related processes that can be stopped together.
definition: A set of related processes that can be stopped together.

title: builtin sandbox
summary: The default sandbox: a subprocess with limits.
definition: The default sandbox: a subprocess with limits.

title: external sandbox
summary: A sandbox server reached over HTTP.
definition: A sandbox server reached over HTTP.

title: venv
summary: A Python virtual environment.
definition: A Python virtual environment.

title: secret vault
summary: A file of named secrets filled in at run time.
definition: A file of named secrets filled in at run time.

title: placeholder
summary: A name like {=NAME=} standing in for a secret.
definition: A name like {=NAME=} standing in for a secret.

title: redaction
summary: Replacing secret text in output.
definition: Replacing secret text in output.

title: prompt injection
summary: Text that tries to give the model new orders.
definition: Text that tries to give the model new orders.

title: content guard
summary: The check that flags injection-like text.
definition: The check that flags injection-like text.

title: SSRF
summary: Tricking a server into requesting private addresses.
definition: Tricking a server into requesting private addresses.

title: MCP
summary: Model Context Protocol, a way to connect tools. Not wired in here.
definition: Model Context Protocol, a way to connect tools. Not wired in here.

title: embeddings
summary: Numbers that capture the meaning of text.
definition: Numbers that capture the meaning of text.

title: vector search
summary: Search by meaning using embeddings.
definition: Search by meaning using embeddings.

title: knowledge graph
summary: Nodes and links between ideas.
definition: Nodes and links between ideas.

title: episodic log
summary: A dated, append-only list of events.
definition: A dated, append-only list of events.

title: skill
summary: A Markdown file of instructions the agent can load.
definition: A Markdown file of instructions the agent can load.

title: Super Skill
summary: The index of all skills.
definition: The index of all skills.

title: vault folder
summary: The folder of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian.
definition: The folder of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian.

title: supervisor
summary: The process that runs the bot and watches for updates.
definition: The process that runs the bot and watches for updates.

title: rollback
summary: Returning to the last good commit.
definition: Returning to the last good commit.

title: tier
summary: A model level: small, medium or power.
definition: A model level: small, medium or power.

title: escalation
summary: Handing a task to the power model.
definition: Handing a task to the power model.

title: fallback
summary: The next model tried when one fails.
definition: The next model tried when one fails.

title: handoff
summary: The package given to the power model.
definition: The package given to the power model.

title: provider
summary: The service that serves the model.
definition: The service that serves the model.

title: scheduled job
summary: A saved prompt that runs on a timer.
definition: A saved prompt that runs on a timer.

title: CRON_SAFE tools
summary: The read-only tools scheduled jobs may use.
definition: The read-only tools scheduled jobs may use.

title: operator
summary: The person who runs the server.
definition: The person who runs the server.

title: owner
summary: The person on the allow-list who chats with the bot.
definition: The person on the allow-list who chats with the bot.

title: session
summary: One chat's history and state.
definition: One chat's history and state.

title: context compressor
summary: The step that shortens long history.
definition: The step that shortens long history.

title: progress line
summary: A short live message about a tool call.
definition: A short live message about a tool call.

title: pending approval
summary: A saved request waiting for a button.
definition: A saved request waiting for a button.
